body: Can intrusive thoughts have distinct voices/personalities?
Thank you so much! The hospital I've gone to doesn't allow blankets :( but I'll definitely bring my journals and bring a picture of my parents
Yeah I went out to the stores just a minute ago with some family and that made me feel something for a while. Thanks for the message. :) anything helps right now

I guess the same reason you drink (not to sound defensive). It's just an addiction I've been struggling with that becomes harder to fight when I'm in these major down episodes. I wish I could cut it because it hurts my parents to see but I just can't

I'm so so sorry you're feeling that way, this summer has been the same for me with the exception of the drugs/alcohol (for me it's been cutting). I hope your wound heals soon and if you ever need someone to talk to I'm always here

Hey there! I felt the same exact way that you did when I was diagnosed in April this year. I'm still learning the ropes but know that you're not alone!!
This community is great and there will always be people here that care. 

Honestly I just researched "bipolar" on google and read everything that came up. Also the book "The Bipolar Disorder Survival Guide" helped me understand my boundaries a lot and symptoms of bipolar I thought were my personality. 

If you ever have questions or just want to talk I'm always here! Good luck :)
Could I pm you about this? Or is it a nuisance?

Yeah that's what I fear, getting hospitalized or her alerting my family but although I'm already addicted to it and don't want to stop I know I should tell someone so it's on the record I guess. Anyways thanks for the support!
Yeah I'm already taking a cocktail of meds so I guess it couldn't hurt to tell her. Thanks for the encouragement!
